title: Design receipt state-store normalization path
goal: Define a safe path for normalizing historical task_status receipt rows that are superseded by current embedded registry verification.

metadata.source: Registered after PR #253 classified superseded receipt drift as non-blocking but did not rewrite the state database.
metadata.safety_boundary: No state DB rewrite without backup, dry-run, receipt hash inventory and rollback documentation.

lease_scope_migration.rationale: Receipt normalization is bounded to StateStore handling and Registry verification reconciliation.
does_not_establish: safe mutation of terminal historical tasks

metadata.outcome: Implemented by Bureau PR #1546. The exact merge commit is deployed as the immutable Bureau release. Live dry-run against the current state database found no T139 row requiring normalization, so no state rewrite or backup was necessary; runtime-drift-check remained successful and classified remaining historical receipt drift as non-blocking embedded-verification history.
validation: PR #1546 required checks passed on exact head 3ca86c5537811310e6e3ced5ec39b71108daf5dc for Python 3.10, Python 3.12, CodeQL and registry preflight.
PR #1546 merged through the merge queue as 8d35f6489e3fdbef5365fb20464577c387768051.
Managed Bureau runtime identity and canonical Registry snapshot both read back exact commit 8d35f6489e3fdbef5365fb20464577c387768051 with valid manifest, inventory and tree digests.
Live receipt-normalize --dry-run returned status ok and an empty normalizable inventory for GRABOWSKI-OPERATOR-SURFACE-V1-T139.
No apply was attempted because the exact inventory was empty; therefore no database backup waiver, row mutation or history deletion occurred.
Live runtime-drift-check returned exit code 0, state integrity ok, no stale_tasks and only informational superseded receipt history plus the pre-existing initiative lifecycle warning.

verified_acceptance.dry-run-inventory: The deployed command returned the exact T139 inventory as an empty list, proving no current row requires normalization.
verified_acceptance.backup-required: Apply was correctly skipped because the inventory was empty; the implementation and regression tests require a backup for every non-empty apply.
verified_acceptance.history-preserved: No state row was changed or deleted. The implementation tests cover audit-event preservation for an actual apply.
verified_acceptance.runtime-drift-clear: Live runtime-drift-check completed successfully with no true stale receipt blocker and state database integrity ok.

verification.verification_note: Exact implementation head was green, merge-queue integration and immutable runtime deployment were read back, live dry-run required no mutation, and runtime-drift-check remained successful.

acceptance.assertion: Tool lists exact task_status rows that would be normalized and the embedded registry verification that supersedes them.
Apply requires a state DB backup or explicit reviewed backup waiver.
Historical receipt rows are not deleted; any normalization preserves receipt references or writes an audit event.
After normalization, runtime-drift-check remains ok and no true stale receipt blocker is hidden.
